options.name: ckd_type
options.description: The type of lss to create.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: id
options.description: The lss ID to be created. An lss ID is two hexadecimal characters 00 - FE.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the DS8000 storage system I(username).

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The subsystem ID that you assign. A subsystem ID is four hexadecimal characters 0000-FFFF. Required when I(state=present)

options.name: state
options.description: Specify the state the DS8000 lss should be in.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the DS8000 storage system.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Controls validation of SSL chain of trust. Set to C(no) to allow connection when SSL certificates are not trusted.
